evals.name: stateless-table-matches
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-states

architecture_dir is docs/architecture. The checkout has one Stateless machine: new StateMachine<OrderState, OrderTrigger>(OrderState.New), Configure/Permit from New to Paid. Paid is targeted and has no outgoing permit. A state Archived is declared with Configure and is never a target. This is a non-interactive run.
evals.expected_output: Runs collect-states.sh and render-states.sh. Writes states.json and states.md. Confidence is high. Archived is an unreachable finding. Paid is a terminal_inferred finding, not a dead_end. The diagram is a mermaid stateDiagram-v2.
expectations: Runs ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/scripts/collect-states.sh rather than composing the diagram by hand
Writes states.json before rendering, then runs render-states.sh to produce states.md
The Permit transition cites the declaring file
The never-targeted state is an unreachable finding
The targeted state with no outgoing permit is a terminal_inferred finding and is not reported as a dead-end
states.md contains stateDiagram-v2 and states that landscape_dialect is not read
Does not add a dialect key

evals.name: ad-hoc-assignments-refuse
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-states

architecture_dir is docs/architecture. The only evidence is order.Status = OrderStatus.Shipped. The operator wants a diagram anyway.
evals.expected_output: The record is a refusal with reason ad-hoc. render-states.sh exits 3, prints the reason on stderr and no summary line, and no states.md is written.
expectations: Does not draw a transition from the status assignment
Reports the refusal and its reason from the renderer's exit-3 message
Writes no states.md and does not present a diagram

evals.name: two-entities-need-a-name
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-states

architecture_dir is docs/architecture. The checkout declares two explicit machines. No entity argument was given.
evals.expected_output: render-states.sh exits 3, names both entities, and writes no diagram until --entity selects one.
expectations: Exits 3 when several entities are present and --entity is omitted
Draws a diagram only after --entity selects one
